answer: The horizon graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the signal audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the forge checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 79 keys loses far more than 79 single identities would. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
